description: Hand-written synthetic name-collision scenarios. Each has two folders sharing a name; answer = folder id the statement belongs in, or 'ask'. No private data.

scenarios.name: Rohan
scenarios.kind: two people, same first name (colleague vs cousin)

facts.text: Rohan joined my team at Kestrel Logistics as a backend engineer.
Rohan sits next to me and drinks only black coffee.
Rohan led the migration to Postgres at work.
Rohan has been interviewing at a startup in Berlin.
Rohan is on my team's on-call rota every second week.
My cousin Rohan lives in Pune and works as a dentist.

statements.text: Rohan broke the build again just before the on-call handover.

statements.why: colleague was interviewing in Berlin; cousin said he'd never leave Pune; no explicit marker

statements.text: Rohan called me last night and sounded really stressed.
